properties.description:
Every branch of the loop nudge to date reasons from the session's own op TALLY — writes since a loop check, edits, ChangeEvents recorded, skills loaded. That is a proxy for design debt, and it is blind in the direction that matters: a session that does the loop's motions correctly (write, then loop_status) trips nothing, whatever it actually left behind in the graph.

This capability adds the branch that asks the GRAPH. A detached probe calls `loop_status` over the shared server's stateless MCP surface, records a BASELINE at SessionStart, and compares later probes against it. The nudge fires only on a count this session RAISED — never on a level, because the standing debt is weeks old and a level fires forever.

It speaks LAST, where the counting branches are silent, and shares their once-per-session budget: the session that already got a counting nudge does not get a second interruption.

DEGRADATION IS SILENT AND DELIBERATE. No `.reflow2/graph.server.json` (no shared server), an unreachable server, or a probe that never returns all leave the nudge saying nothing. A hook that guesses when it cannot read is worse than one that does not speak.

⚠ THE READING CAN BE STALE, AND THAT IS THE PRICE OF THE ASYNC SHAPE. The verdict is whatever the last probe found — held at up to a couple of minutes by the debounce, and longer where no probe has been spawned since. A session genuinely in flight RAISES counts and then SETTLES them: capture intent and the gaps appear, wire the thread and they close. Observed on the session that built this, where unsurfaced gaps read 7 → 10 while the new nodes were unwired and finished at 6. So the message states the reading's AGE and tells the agent to confirm with `loop_status` before acting. Waiting for a fresh probe at stop time is the 23-second block the whole design exists to avoid.

WHAT IT CANNOT DO, stated because the gap is real: the graph cannot see the transcript, so this reports what the DESIGN says changed, never what the conversation held and failed to write down. It complements the capture-session skill; it does not replace it.

(The Decision this implements is `dec:the-stop-hook-asks-the-graph-asynchronously`; that node holds the cost measurement and the roads not taken, this one holds what the mechanism does.)
properties.name: The Stop nudge asks the graph what this session left, instead of counting the session's own tool calls
